ns2:course.label: Professional Internship
ns2:course.description: Professional work with an approved host theatre or institution in an area related to the student's academic program; exposure to and participation in professional theatre. Full documentation and approval of internship activities required. 0 to 14 undergraduate hours, or 0 to 12 graduate hours. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms as topics vary. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Junior, senior, or graduate standing in Theatre; consent of Internship Coordinator.
